subject.title: fix: models status auth, browser local-file nav, codex workspace app-server, tui empty sessions

question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns become network-enabled by default, or must network stay denied unless an explicit opt-in path is approved?
rationale: This is a security-boundary and upgrade-default choice; source review can identify the risk, but only maintainers can approve changing the default sandbox contract.

options.title: Keep Default Denied
options.body: Restore workspace-write networkAccess false and use a separate explicit opt-in or existing network-proxy path for egress.

options.title: Approve Default Egress
options.body: Accept network-enabled workspace-write as a deliberate product/security change with matching docs, tests, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split The Bundle
options.body: Move TUI, browser, and models-status fixes separately while pausing the sandbox-default decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Default Denied
recommendation.body: Restore workspace-write networkAccess false and use a separate explicit opt-in or existing network-proxy path for egress.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent current-main history across the touched sandbox/auth/browser paths and merged the central current-main changes.
